text: Android: a forced logout wipes the local mirror including unpushed edits

Landed in 4f02e79 + 6d71bc3. New SessionState.mirrorAccountId outlives the session; login wipes only when the returning account differs (an unrecorded owner counts as different, so privacy wins the tie). The agent also deferred the wipe on EXPLICIT logout, which I narrowed in 6d71bc3: logout now drops the rows the server can send again and keeps only unpushed and quarantined ones, since clearing the session resets the cursor and the next login re-pulls anyway — no reason for a logged-out device to hold a full mirror. Mutation-checked both ways.
